title: Cauliflower Cheese Pasta Bake
subtitle: with Peas and Crunchy Panko Topping
description: Whether you're full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they're packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they're totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to the boil for the pasta and peas. Cut the cauliflower stem into 1cm chunks and cut the head into small florets. Coarsely grate the cheese. To make the stock, put the country seasoning and 375ml (1½ cups) boiling water in a heatproof jug and stir to dissolve.

Cook pasta and peas: Preheat the grill to high. Grease a 1.75L (7 cup) baking dish. Cook the pasta in the pan of boiling water for 8 mins. Add the peas and cook for a further 2 mins or until the pasta is al dente and the peas are tender. Drain and return to the pan.

Cook cauliflower: Meanwhile, combine 2 tsp olive oil and 2 tsp white wine vinegar in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Heat 2 tsp olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Cook the cauliflower, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until browned. Add 1 tbs water, cover and cook for a further 4-5 mins until tender. Remove from the pan.

Make cheese sauce: Melt 20g butter in the same pan over medium heat. Add 1 tbs plain flour and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until golden. Stir in the stock and 60ml (¼ cup) milk until smooth, then bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until slightly thickened. Stir in the cheese until melted. Season with salt and pepper. Remove from the heat.

Grill and serve up: Add the cauliflower and cheese sauce to the pasta and peas and stir to combine. Transfer to the baking dish and scatter over the breadcrumbs (see Make it yours). Grill for 5 mins or until golden. Add the spinach to the dressing and toss to coat. Divide the pasta bake and spinach salad among plates and enjoy!
Make it yours: Like it extra cheesy? If you have some on hand, scatter some grated cheese over the breadcrumbs before grilling the pasta bake.
